how: Crazy Park in Bonneuil-sur-Marne has the Ile-de-France region's only year-round indoor ski simulator, and temporary snow and luge slopes appear in winter.
Paris has large Meetup communities plus friend-making platforms such as Frimake that organise interest-based outings among strangers.
The Sevres Chaville VTT club leads guided mountain-bike outings in the Foret de Meudon, run with Grand Paris Seine Ouest.

The City of Paris runs adult fin-swimming (nage avec palmes) courses at the Espace Sportif Pontoise pool, a pool-based version of fins-and-snorkel swimming; open-water snorkelling is not available locally.

An annual mineral, fossil and gem fair at the Institut national du judo (Paris 14e) draws collectors, with the AMIS association of the Jussieu Sorbonne mineral collection taking part; no regular field-collecting club was confirmed.
